claims.claim_text: This supports the authenticity of the image.

notes: The center-left location matches the annotation, but the object attributed to that region is wrong: the box encloses a standing black-and-white cow, while the house it names sits further up and to the right. The house is not hallucinated - it genuinely appears in the scene - but it is not the annotated content. The explanation also contradicts itself, calling the score a strong indication of alteration and then concluding the image is authentic.
